messages:
maya: Heads-up — ZenoSilicon confirmed a joint perf/W sweep next week. We need a concise playbook and lab handoff so their team can run with minimal blocking. ETA: 3-day window starting Monday.

sam: Link to draft playbook: https://redwood-internal/notes/zeno-soc-playbook (will push scripts and dashboards there).

nina: Quick Q — do we include thermal throttling stability runs? I'd say yes, 30min steady-state at each point.

ryan: +1 to stability. Also request per-core power telemetry from Zeno (their board sensors). They said they'll expose a prometheus exporter. @sam can you prep a Grafana board?

sam: Yep — will provision a dashboard. Initial checklist I'm adding to the doc: 1) external power meter on PSU, 2) IPMI sampling @1s, 3) perf counters (topdown), 4) `dmesg` capture, 5) NVLink health logs.

maya: Core metrics to capture: throughput (tokens/s), p50/p95/p99 latency, perf/W (tokens/J), sustained power (W), GPU temp, and model accuracy pass rate. Also tag every run with `run_id` + `git_sha`.

zeno_integration_bot: Zeno infra update: Provisioned 4x ZS-32 nodes, kernel=5.19, nvidia-rt-driver=520. Prometheus ingress endpoint: https://prom.zeno/exports/zeno-19765. Logs are forwarded to s3://zeno-handshake/bench-19765.

nina: For kernel knobs we should test both default and tuned sets. Proposed knobs list: a) `rcu_nocbs=all`, b) `intel_pstate=disable`, c) `intel_idle.max_cstate=1`, d) `nv_peer_mem=1`.

ryan: I'll add those to the run matrix. Also include firmware/BIOS versions and exact kernel cmdline in metadata so we can replay.

maya: Model variants to evaluate: fp16 baseline, int8-quantized (QAT where available), and mixed-GQA profiles. Batches: 1,4,8,16. Sequences: 64 and 512. Warmup: 10k prefix tokens before logging steady-state.

sam: Putting a quick run snippet in the doc for standardization:

```
for bs in 1 4 8 16; do
  ./run_infer.sh --model redwood/rtx-13b --batch $bs --seq 512 --profile prom --duration 1800 --label "zeno-1976502468-$bs"
done
```

This will emit prometheus metrics and create a `run_metadata.json` per run.

nina: Add `dmesg -w` and `journalctl -f` to capture transient NVLink or driver issues. We saw an NVLink flake on 32-sku last week; want to catch it early.

maya: Schedule proposal: Mon 09:00 PT start, dry-run Fri 14:00 PT (validation with Zeno), 3-day run window Mon–Wed. Zeno engineers will pair Mon/Tue mornings for triage.

ryan: Action items: @sam — dashboard + `run_metadata.json` template + set data retention to 90d; @nina — kernel knobs doc + logging playbook; @maya — announcement/PR checklist and legal signoff steps; @zeno_integration_bot — confirm prometheus scrape interval and S3 retention.

zeno_integration_bot: Confirming scrape_interval=1s set on our exporter. Current S3 retention=30d; requesting 90d bump with infra.

sam: Noted. I'll also add an automated parser that converts prometheus series into per-run perf/W CSVs and pushes them to the shared bucket.

nina: Minor gotcha: please ensure we capture `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu` at 1s for correlation with power meter.

maya: Good call. Also make sure we store `git_sha` and full `uname -a` in `run_metadata.json`. Dry-run Fri 14:00 PT — I'll calendar invite.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll lock in dashboard and add alerts for >5% variance across repeated runs.

maya: Thanks everyone — will loop in legal and comms for announcement gating. If Zeno agrees to public numbers we need a joint preview and embargo.

zeno_integration_bot: Zeno ack: will ask infra for S3 retention bump and has assigned eng contact `amiya-zeno` for pairing.

sam: OK wrapping up — next checkpoint Fri dry-run. Files to check: playbook doc, run scripts, grafana dashboard, and `run_metadata.json` template.

maya: Perfect. Closing thread for now — will update the doc with meeting invite and final run matrix. :party_parrot:
